scripts.prebuild: npm run profile:build && npm run logos:build && npm run engine:build
scripts.dev: npm run prebuild && npm -w apps/web run dev
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm -w workers/api run dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm -w workers/api run deploy
scripts.check: npm -w apps/web run check && npm -w workers/api run check && cargo clippy --manifest-path engine/mancala/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
